name: tapsmith
description: Write, run and debug Tapsmith mobile tests: the Tapsmith MCP server, run from the project's own install and working in its UI-mode session when one is running, and a skill for finding locators, structuring tests and reading failed traces.

interface.shortDescription: Mobile tests with a Playwright-style API
interface.longDescription: Write, run and debug Tapsmith tests for Android and iOS apps. The plugin starts the project's own Tapsmith MCP server, so the agent can read the live accessibility tree, prove each locator before using it, run one test and read a failed test's trace. With Tapsmith's UI mode running (tapsmith test --ui), the agent works in that session and you watch it; without, it runs headless. Its skill points the agent at the docs that ship with the installed Tapsmith version.
defaultPrompt: Write a Tapsmith test for the sign-in flow
Find a reliable locator for the Save button
Why did this Tapsmith test fail?
